title: LightVAE: Towards Compact and Efficient Video Autoencoders
title_zh: LightVAE：迈向紧凑高效的视频自编码器

paragraphs.en: Latent diffusion models enable high-quality video generation, but video VAE encoding and decoding remain computationally expensive. Existing methods use stage-specific lightweight operators, yet either constrain spatial and temporal computation jointly or remove temporal computation altogether, without distinguishing their compression sensitivities in pretrained Conv3D. To address these limitations, we present LightVAE, a compression framework that exploits redundancy in temporal modeling and network depth. LightVAE exactly reparameterizes eligible causal Conv3D layers into an aggregate spatial response and a difference-driven temporal correction. Based on their distinct compression sensitivities, temporal low-rank compression (TLR) keeps the aggregate spatial kernel dense and applies layer-specific low-rank approximation only to the temporal correction. An algebraically equivalent folded implementation converts the arithmetic savings into practical acceleration. LightVAE further uses width-preserving block pruning to reduce depth and probe-guided feature alignment, guided by feedback from a frozen teacher suffix, to recover quality after compression. The framework also extends to video encoders. Across three video VAE backbones and two GPU platforms, LightVAE consistently accelerates decoding. For the Wan VAE family, it achieves up to 2.24 × 2.24\times and 1.11 × 1.11\times the decoding throughput of state-of-the-art efficient VAE decoders on NVIDIA H100 and RTX 5090, respectively, with higher DAVIS PSNR and lower LPIPS. On MiniMax-H3, it achieves up to 2.97 × 2.97\times the original decoding throughput while retaining 99.51% of the original model’s overall VBench-2.0 score. Our code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE .

paragraphs.en: Recent video generation models have advanced in visual fidelity, motion coherence, and prompt alignment ( Yang et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ; Team Wan and others, 2025 ) . Many operate in a latent space ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , where a video variational autoencoder (VAE) maps between pixels and compact spatiotemporal representations, while a diffusion Transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) generates video latents through iterative denoising. Although this design reduces generation cost, both denoising and VAE inference remain expensive for high-resolution or long videos. Most acceleration methods target denoising. Diffusion distillation reduces the number of sampling steps ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) ; caching reuses computation across steps ( Liu et al., 2025 ) ; and efficient attention, quantization, and optimized kernels reduce per-step cost ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; LightX2V Contributors, 2025 ) . As denoising becomes faster, VAE inference can account for a larger fraction of end-to-end latency ( Zou et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . In convolutional video VAEs, causal Conv3D becomes particularly expensive in high-resolution decoder stages, where dense spatiotemporal kernels operate on large feature maps. We therefore focus primarily on decoder compression.

paragraphs.en: A practical approach is to compress a pretrained decoder while preserving its latent interface and recovering quality through teacher supervision. Turbo-VAED ( Zou et al., 2026 ) replaces dense Conv3D with depthwise-separable Conv3D in low-resolution stages while retaining dense Conv3D at higher resolutions. Flash-VAED ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) further combines depthwise-separable Conv3D with channel-pruned Conv2D in high-resolution stages. Flash-VAED’s stage-wise replacement experiments show that substituting Conv3D with Conv2D in later, higher-resolution stages yields greater latency reductions with smaller quality losses, providing an empirical basis for reducing temporal computation in these stages. However, the depthwise-separable Conv3D used by both methods constrains joint spatial filtering and channel mixing, limiting its ability to reproduce pretrained dense-convolution responses. Flash-VAED’s pruned Conv2D removes local temporal interactions while also narrowing spatial representations, restricting the spatial mappings inherited from the teacher. Conv2D replacement fixes the affected layers to spatial-only processing rather than providing adjustable temporal capacity. These observations motivate examining whether the spatial and temporal contributions of pretrained Conv3D have different compression sensitivities.
paragraphs.zh: 一种实用方法是压缩预训练解码器，同时保留其潜在接口，并通过教师监督恢复模型质量。 Turbo-VAED（Zou 等，2026）在低分辨率阶段用深度可分离 Conv3D 替代密集 Conv3D，而在更高分辨率阶段仍保留密集 Conv3D。 Flash-VAED（Zhu 等，2026）进一步将深度可分离 Conv3D 与通道剪枝后的 Conv2D 结合使用于高分辨率阶段。 Flash-VAED 的分阶段替换实验表明，在后期高分辨率阶段用 Conv2D 替代 Conv3D 能带来更大的延迟降低且质量损失更小，这为减少这些阶段的时间计算提供了经验依据。 然而，两种方法都使用的深度可分离 Conv3D 限制了联合空间滤波和通道混合能力，从而削弱了其复现预训练密集卷积响应的能力。 Flash-VAED 中剪枝后的 Conv2D 不仅移除了局部时间交互，还缩小了空间表示，从而限制了从教师模型继承的空间映射。 使用 Conv2D 的替换将受影响的层固定为仅处理空间信息，而非提供可调的时间处理能力。 这些观察结果促使我们进一步研究：预训练 Conv3D 的空间贡献和时间贡献是否具有不同的压缩敏感度。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this question, we introduce LightVAE , a compression framework that combines two complementary forms of structural compression: temporal low-rank compression (TLR) within eligible convolutions and width-preserving pruning across network blocks (Figure 1 ). TLR reduces temporal computation within retained layers, whereas block pruning reduces network depth without narrowing the retained feature representations. LightVAE further uses an algebraically equivalent folded implementation for efficient TLR execution and probe-guided feature alignment for reconstruction recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 受此问题启发，我们提出了 LightVAE——一种压缩框架，它将两种互补的结构压缩形式相结合：在合格卷积中的时序低秩压缩（TLR），以及跨网络块的宽度保留剪枝（图 1）。 TLR 减少了保留层内的时序计算量，而块剪枝则在不缩小保留特征表示的前提下降低了网络深度。 LightVAE 还采用了一种代数等价的折叠实现来高效执行 TLR，并通过探针引导的特征对齐来实现重建恢复。

paragraphs.en: TLR begins with an exact reparameterization of pretrained causal Conv3D that expresses its output as an aggregate spatial response plus a temporal correction driven by historical–current feature differences. Under the same cumulative singular-value retention criterion, our branch-specific ablations show that temporal-only factorization produces smaller decoder-output errors than spatial-only or joint factorization, while joint-factorization errors remain close to those of spatial-only factorization. These results lead to TLRConv2D, a stateful operator that keeps the aggregate spatial kernel dense and applies truncated SVD only to the temporal correction. Layer-specific ranks control temporal capacity and computational cost; Figure 2 illustrates the fidelity benefit of retaining the correction. To translate the reduced arithmetic into wall-clock gains, we derive an algebraically equivalent folded implementation that absorbs the current-frame correction into the spatial kernel and caches low-dimensional history projections. This implementation avoids explicit online feature differences, reduces convolution calls and intermediate tensors without additional rank truncation, and improves measured throughput on both evaluated GPUs.
paragraphs.zh: TLR 首先对预训练的因果 Conv3D 模型进行精确的重参数化，将其输出表示为空间聚合响应与由历史-当前特征差异驱动的时间修正项之和。 在相同的累积奇异值保留标准下，我们针对各分支进行的消融分析表明：仅基于时间的因子分解产生的解码器输出误差小于仅基于空间或联合因子分解的结果，而联合因子分解的误差仍接近仅基于空间的因子分解结果。 这些研究结果催生了 TLRConv2D——一种状态化算子，它保持空间聚合核为密集形式，并仅对时间修正项应用截断奇异值分解（SVD）。 各层的秩控制着时间维度的容量与计算成本；图 2 展示了保留修正项所带来的保真度提升。 为了将减少的算术运算量转化为实际运行时间的增益，我们推导出了一个代数等价的折叠实现方案：它将当前帧的修正项融入空间核中，并对低维的历史投影进行缓存。 该实现避免了显式的在线特征差异计算，减少了卷积调用和中间张量的数量，且无需额外的秩截断操作，同时在所有评估的 GPU 上均提升了实测吞吐量。

sents.en: This implementation avoids explicit online feature differences, reduces convolution calls and intermediate tensors without additional rank truncation, and improves measured throughput on both evaluated GPUs.

paragraphs.en: At the depth level, high shortcut–output cosine similarity suggests potential block redundancy (Figure 9 ). We therefore complement TLR with width-preserving block pruning, adapting TinyFusion’s recoverability-aware search ( Fang et al., 2025 ) to convolutional and Transformer blocks while retaining required shortcuts, projections, and resampling operations. This depth reduction is complementary to TLR because it acts across blocks rather than within retained temporal convolutions. For reconstruction recovery, uniform feature MSE weights coordinates equally without accounting for their downstream effects. We instead introduce probe-guided feature alignment, which combines gradients from a frozen teacher suffix with signed student–teacher feature discrepancies to construct detached weights. These weights suppress matching directions that locally increase the probe loss in feature space, while the probe loss itself is excluded from the recovery objective.

paragraphs.en: Video autoencoder acceleration explores lightweight architectures ( Cheng and Yuan, 2025 ) and compression of pretrained decoders ( Zou et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , the latter preserving the latent interface of an existing diffusion backbone. Turbo-VAED ( Zou et al., 2026 ) uses depthwise-separable Conv3D in low-resolution stages and dense Conv3D at higher resolutions. Flash-VAED ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) combines depthwise-separable Conv3D with channel-pruned Conv2D, demonstrating that later stages tolerate reduced temporal computation. Depthwise-separable Conv3D constrains joint spatial filtering and channel mixing, while channel-pruned Conv2D removes local temporal interactions and narrows spatial representations. Prior work also factorizes spatiotemporal convolutions ( Qiu et al., 2017 ; Tran et al., 2018 ) or applies low-rank kernel approximation ( Lebedev et al., 2015 ) . TLR instead exactly separates an aggregate spatial response from a difference-driven temporal correction, preserving the dense spatial kernel at conversion while controlling temporal capacity through layer-specific ranks.
paragraphs.zh: 视频自动编码器加速技术探索了轻量化架构（Cheng和Yuan，2025）以及对预训练解码器的压缩方法（Zou等，2026；Zhu等，2026），其中后者保留了现有扩散模型主干网络的潜在接口。 Turbo-VAED（Zou等，2026）在低分辨率阶段使用深度可分离的Conv3D，而在更高分辨率阶段则使用密集Conv3D。 Flash-VAED（Zhu等，2026）将深度可分离的Conv3D与通道剪枝的Conv2D相结合，证明了后续阶段能够容忍较低的时间维度计算量。 深度可分离的Conv3D限制了空间滤波与通道混合的联合操作，而通道剪枝的Conv2D则消除了局部时间交互并缩小了空间表示。 先前的研究还通过因子分解时空卷积（Qiu等，2017；Tran等，2018）或应用低秩核近似方法（Lebedev等，2015）来实现优化。 TLR则精确地将聚合空间响应与差异驱动的时间修正分离开来，在转换过程中保留了密集的空间核，同时通过层特定的秩来控制时间维度的容量。

paragraphs.en: Channel pruning reduces network width ( He et al., 2017 ) , whereas block pruning reduces depth while preserving the feature widths of retained blocks. TinyFusion ( Fang et al., 2025 ) jointly learns structural selection and parameter adaptation to identify diffusion Transformers with strong post-pruning recoverability. LightVAE adapts this search principle to convolutional and Transformer blocks in video autoencoders. Reconstruction recovery commonly uses output or intermediate-feature distillation ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Romero et al., 2015 ) . CrossKD ( Wang et al., 2024 ) passes student features through a teacher detection head and directly distills the resulting cross-head predictions. Gradient-Guided Knowledge Distillation ( Lan and Tian, 2024 ) uses task gradients to weight task-relevant features during distillation. LightVAE instead uses gradients from a frozen teacher-suffix probe, together with signed student–teacher feature discrepancies, to construct detached feature-alignment weights. These weights suppress matching directions that locally increase the probe loss in feature space. Unlike direct cross-head prediction distillation, the probe loss itself is excluded from the recovery objective.

At conversion, 𝑺 {\bm{S}} is preserved exactly, and the temporal factors are initialized from pretrained weights by SVD. paragraphs.en: Tables 1 and 2 summarize LightVAE’s speed–quality trade-offs. On Wan2.1, Lite achieves 1.12 × 1.12\times / 1.11 × 1.11\times the throughput of Flash-VAED on H100/RTX 5090, with higher DAVIS PSNR and lower LPIPS, while Pro closely preserves the original reconstruction quality. On Wan2.2, Pro surpasses Turbo-VAED on all reconstruction metrics across both datasets while achieving higher H100 throughput (38.84 vs. 29.24 FPS). Across the Wan VAEs, Lite reaches up to 4.06 × 4.06\times / 4.20 × 4.20\times the original throughput on H100/RTX 5090. On RTX 5090, Wan2.2 Lite reaches 31.87 FPS, whereas Turbo-VAED runs out of memory under our 81-frame protocol, compared with the standard 17-frame evaluation in its original paper ( Zou et al., 2026 ) . Both LightVAE variants use r = 0 r=0 in the converted up2 / up3 residual convolutions, consistent with evidence that later stages tolerate reduced temporal computation ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . The ablations in Section 5.3 separately show that TLR gives the lowest matched-MAC error among the tested allocations, block pruning reaches higher recovered PSNR than channel pruning at similar pre-recovery throughput, probe-guided recovery improves over reconstruction-only recovery, and folding increases throughput on both GPUs. On MiniMax-H3, Lite achieves 2.95 × 2.95\times / 2.97 × 2.97\times the original decoding throughput on H100/RTX 5090 while retaining 99.51% of the original VBench-2.0 overall score. Reference encoding is accelerated by up to 2.68 × 2.68\times , with jointly compressed encoders and decoders producing visually similar outputs. paragraphs.en: We presented LightVAE, combining temporal low-rank compression, folded execution, width-preserving block pruning, and probe-guided recovery. It achieves up to 2.24 × 2.24\times / 1.11 × 1.11\times the throughput of evaluated efficient Wan decoders on H100/RTX 5090 with higher DAVIS PSNR and lower LPIPS. On MiniMax-H3, block pruning provides up to 2.97 × 2.97\times decoding throughput while retaining 99.51% of the VBench-2.0 score, and extends to efficient reference encoding.

paragraphs.en: The convolutional evaluation of TLR currently focuses on the Wan VAE family; the MiniMax-H3 experiments evaluate block pruning rather than TLR. Temporal ranks are selected from weight spectra, block retention follows predefined group-wise quotas, and measured latency depends on hardware and implementation. In addition, the probe weighting provides a local feature-space alignment property rather than a parameter-space descent guarantee. Future work could learn ranks and retention counts jointly from activation and latency statistics and evaluate TLR across additional video-autoencoder families.

paragraphs.en: Operator ablations preserve the original Wan2.1 decoder depth and width. Conv2D uses summed temporal kernel slices. The DW3D+PW/Conv2D hybrids follow Flash-VAED’s operator layout ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , with random-DW or teacher-SVD initialization, excluding its channel pruning and training recipe. paragraphs.en: The original decoder costs approximately 137.68 TMAC per video. Counting convolutions and attention matrix products, the rank-one minimum yields MAC floors of 69.86% for spatial-only compression, 39.70% for TLR, and 39.72% for the equal-saving joint baseline. paragraphs.en: We evaluate joint encoder–decoder compression in MiniMax-H3 reference-conditioned generation. LightVAE-Lite reduces the encoder from 12 to 6 residual main branches and the decoder from 36 to 12 Transformer blocks, while retaining required shortcuts, projections, and resampling operations.
